name: AI assistant hero over a background-video stage
purpose: Introduce the AI assistant product with a cinematic video stage, the H1 and two CTAs (demo + ask an AI).
description: Full-width stage (/nova) 85vh tall (max 60rem) holding a centred 1440:500 background-video band; under it a centred block (max 42rem): serif 4rem/1.1 H1 with one italic word, grey intro with a bold phrase, and primary + dark buttons (the dark one carries an AI icon). <=767 the block is pulled up -12rem over the stage; <=479 the video band becomes 3:2, 15rem tall.
